notes:
CONVENTIONS: GB are decimal. For diffusion and video models, q4_gb, q8_gb and fp16_gb give the size of the main transformer/UNet only, as GGUF Q4_K_M (Q4_K_S for FLUX.1, where city96 has no K_M) / Q8_0 / BF16. Text encoders are extra, and some are large: T5-XXL is ~4.9GB fp8, Qwen2.5-VL-7B ~8GB fp8, Mistral Small 24B for FLUX.2 dev ~24GB fp8, Gemma 12B for LTX-2.5.

min_runtime_mem_gb for image and video models is the practical NVIDIA VRAM at the commonly used quant (GGUF Q4 or FP8) with ComfyUI offloading and the text encoder at fp8 or offloaded. This offloading needs system RAM of about 2x that figure; for Wan 2.2 A14B, FLUX.2 dev, LTX-2.5 and HunyuanImage 3.0 plan on 64GB. On Apple Silicon, expect about 3-6x slower than an RTX 4090 and roughly 1.5x the memory from unified RAM. AMD ROCm and Intel run slower still. In-browser diffusion is realistic only for SD1.5-class models over WebGPU.

WHISPER: q4_gb is the whisper.cpp q5_0/q5_1 file, the closest official low-bit quant, and fp16_gb is the ggml fp16 file. min_runtime_mem_gb uses whisper.cpp fp16 memory figures; faster-whisper int8 is similar or lower. Where a model has no GGUF, 4/8-bit sizes are estimates (about 0.6x and 1.07x params, fp16 = 2x), marked medium confidence. context_k is 0 where not applicable; audio models work on 30 s windows or stream.

VLM SIZES are Ollama tags and include the vision projector.

EXCLUSIONS AND CAVEATS: Wan 2.5, 2.6 and 3.0 are API-only with no open weights as of 2026-09-29; Wan 2.2 (plus Animate-2 and Dancer offshoots) is the newest open Wan. Some blogs claim Wan 3.0 weights shipped; that is false. Native-multimodal chat LLMs belong in the chat catalog, not here: Gemma 4 (E2B/E4B/26B-A4B/31B, Apache 2.0), Qwen3.5 (0.8B-397B with built-in vision), Llama 4, Mistral Small 3.x. Qwen-Image-2.1 came out 2026-09-20 under a non-commercial licence, so ComfyUI/GGUF support is young. LTX-2.5 (2026-08-11) supersedes LTX-2 19B (Jan 2026) and LTX-2.3 22B (Mar 2026). HunyuanImage 3.0 and FLUX.2 dev effectively need workstation hardware. Tencent Hunyuan licences exclude the EU, UK and South Korea.

SPEEDS in notes are rough reference figures, mostly RTX 3060 12GB, RTX 4090, Apple M-series and i7-12700K CPU. They are for relative ranking, not guarantees.
